subject: Mid-launch Surge Reconciliation & Transition Credit Proposal
messages:
From: Alicia Rowe <alicia.rowe@launchpad.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@launchpad.ai
Date: 2027-09-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected usage spike during launch — reconciliation request

Hi Grace / Ben,

Thanks again for the quick support on Friday while we dealt with the traffic spike. We pulled our logs and attached a short CSV showing the peak window (Sep 20 23:30–Sep 22 03:00 UTC) where we exceeded our committed throughput.

High level: we consumed ~2.3x our committed QPS for ~28 hours. That resulted in several throttled requests and a handful of degraded responses during our marketing rollout.

We’re evaluating options on our side (rate-limiting and gradual rollout), but from a procurement perspective we wanted to understand Redwood’s approach to short-window overrun reconciliation and any one-time credits you might offer for exceptional launch events. Our CFO will need a short explanation to close out the vendor ledger for this quarter.

Can you send a proposal for a remediation path that covers:
- temporary ramped quota for 2 weeks to stabilize (start date Sep 23)
- clarity on overrun invoicing and any goodwill credit for the launch window
- mechanics for the true-up (timing, line items for invoice)

Attachment: launchpad_usage_sep20-22.csv (CSV, 12KB)

Appreciate a fast reply — we have a billing cutover next Friday.

Best,
Alicia Rowe
Head of Platform Operations
Launchpad.ai
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Rowe <alicia.rowe@launchpad.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected usage spike during launch — reconciliation request

Hi Alicia — thanks for the data and the clear ask.

We reviewed the attached usage and the runbook logs from our side. Short answer: we can support a two-part path that should meet Launchpad’s finance and launch stability needs. Summary proposal below, full draft attached: provisional_settlement_draft.pdf

1) Immediate stabilization: Temporary elevated quota (2 weeks) starting Sep 23. We’ll lift your rate limit to the proposed uplift tier and enable a short-term headroom pool so you aren’t throttled while you finish the rollout.

2) One-time reconciliation: We propose a staged overrun true-up. Because this is a one-time, short-window launch event, we can apply a goodwill credit to the overrun portion. Suggested structure:
   - Calculate incremental tokens/requests above committed baseline for Sep 20–22.
   - Apply a 30% credit to the incremental charge for that window.
   - Bill the remaining 70% as a separate invoice line labeled "Launchpad.ai: Sep launch overrun (provisional)" with standard 30-day terms.

3) Procedural/operational notes:
   - We’ll waive any retrospective rate-limit penalty if the uplift is used only for the launch stabilization window.
   - We’ll produce a reconciliation report and a short explanatory memo your finance team can attach to the invoice.

Next steps from our side: Ben will qualify the commercial terms and get an internal approval. Laura — I’m looping you for visibility on the credit and invoice memo.

Attachment: provisional_settlement_draft.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

If that approach works for you I’ll have Ben follow up with the exact dollar figure and DocuSign-ready amendment.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive — High Growth
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Rowe <alicia.rowe@launchpad.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-23T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected usage spike during launch — reconciliation request

Alicia — thanks for the patience while we calibrated numbers. Quick commercial note so you can plan with finance:

We computed the overrun using your CSV and our billing meter. Ballpark (final will show on the reconciliation): incremental charge for Sep 20–22 = $48,600. Proposed settlement:
- Apply a 30% launch goodwill credit = $14,580
- Net payable on overrun = $34,020 (separate invoice)
- Provide a two-week elevated quota (Sep 23–Oct 7) at a blended uplift rate (50% of standard uplift rate) so the effective immediate cost to you for the temporary headroom is minimal.

Operational items:
- We’ll generate an invoice line for the overrun (label described by Grace) with 30-day payment terms.
- We’ll include a short reconciliation memo and the CSV used to compute the meter.
- We’ll prepare a short amendment to your MSA describing the two-week uplift and the one-time credit; signature via DocuSign. Link supplied once internal approvals are complete.

Vivek — looping you up front for a quick exec OK on the 30% credit and the temporary blended uplift. If you’re OK, I’ll get DocuSign ready later today and send the invoice for the net amount.

— Ben
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks team — appreciate the clear proposal. I’m comfortable approving the commercial path below with two operational caveats:

1) Credit & audit trail: Approve the 30% goodwill credit on the incremental overrun and the two-week elevated quota at the blended uplift rate. Before we issue the invoice, Finance will require: final reconciliation CSV, internal meter snapshot, and a one-paragraph note summarizing why this is classified as a one-time launch event. Laura — please make sure the memo includes the timeline and the acceptance clause for the credit.

2) Compliance & billing footnote: For accounts of this size we should include an invoice footnote referencing the temporary uplift and the credit, and include pointers to our SOC2 report and retention policy for the reconciliation artifacts. Alicia — if Launchpad needs SOC2 evidence for procurement, we’ll share the current report through our secure portal.

Ben — proceed to prepare the DocuSign amendment and the provisional invoice for $34,020 (net overrun). Grace — please confirm the two-week uplift start date (Sep 23) in the amendment and make sure the uplift policy is time-limited and non-recurring.

If everyone is aligned I’d like the DocuSign sent before end of day tomorrow.

— Vivek Kulkarni
